milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the mined dark_oak_log item ends up in the player's inventory after breaking the block. The player starts with zero dark_oak_logs, so min_count=1 correctly detects mining. The evaluator checks at every step, so this triggers the moment the log is picked up — even if the player later converts logs to planks. Additionally, 3 logs are available but only 2 are needed for the sign recipe, so the player can retain at least 1 log in inventory throughout.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted dark_oak_sign ends up in the player's inventory and is not present in the starting inventory. The recipe (6 dark_oak_planks + 1 stick) yields 3 signs, so min_count=1 is easily met. The sign has no further use in this task so it will remain in inventory.
